overview_description.description: Tremor is a venture-backed insurance technology firm where world class computer scientists, economists, market designers and industry practitioners are working together to build a modern risk transfer marketplace. Tremor's "smart market" platform incorporates intelligent market design, state-of-the-art auction technology and sophisticated optimization techniques to vastly improve how risk is transferred around the world.

about_short_description.short_description: Tremor designs, builds & manages markets that utilize auction technologies and optimization techniques to improve price and cost efficiency.

product.name: Panorama
product.description: An online platform for pricing and placing reinsurance, enabling users to view market data and control risk pricing and allocation in real time.

product.name: Tremor Wordings™
product.description: A digital solution to manage and finalize reinsurance contract negotiations and approvals, replacing manual document exchanges with a streamlined process.

product.name: TremorTalk™
product.description: An embedded communications platform within the Tremor marketplace that centralizes and streamlines communication between reinsurance market participants.

product.name: Boost!™
product.description: A tool to assist in closing gaps in reinsurance placements by identifying and engaging select markets to cover unpopular risks.

product.name: Tremor Public™
product.description: A platform division focused on providing transparency and market pricing for publicly funded residual insurance markets.

product.name: Tremor Issuer™
product.description: An online platform for issuing catastrophe bonds, accessible to investors, issuers, bankers, and brokers.
